reason: Donut gauge, larger labeled bar chart with a highlighted busiest month and well-formed progress bars give a more polished, legible page than the plainer right side.
The right shows every day as one-scale bars with inline quiet/busy annotations and tidy stat cards, and reads cleanly at phone width, edging out the left's line chart and warning.
Highlighted best/worst table and four small-multiple scatter plots tell the rainfall story clearly, while the left's bar labels collide with the dashed average line.
Per-statement stacked bars with last-year markers and a diverging change chart are clearer and more informative than the left's truncated labels and uniform 100% bars.
Strong hero margin card, shaded table, revenue-split stacked bars and a large clear margin chart make a richer, more polished page despite the swipe table at phone width.
Navy masthead, editorial serif body, pull quote and press-contact card give a far more finished press-release look than the generic left page.
Icon tiles, numbered claim steps, a callout and a closing contact card create clear hierarchy and strong dark-mode phone layout versus the plain bulleted left.
Drop cap, pull quote and numbered tip cards add editorial polish and rhythm to the long read, while the right is a plain wall of text.
Stacked bar breakdowns of the bill and tiers make the explanation more visual and the sections better structured, though one bar label clips on phone.
Warmer, more varied design with a prominent date card and icon list is more engaging, though timeline markers slightly overlap the event titles; the right is clean but plain.
